subject: Training on customer data opt-out - confirmation
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@acmefin.com>
Cc: Tom Lopez <t.lopez@acmefin.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: data handling confirmations + opt-out form

Hi Emily —

Thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap on the items we discussed around data handling so your security team has a single note: 

- PII and sensitive fields: Redwood will not surface any customer PII in model outputs by default; you can provide a field-level allowlist.
- Retention & logs: inference logs (request metadata + prompts) are retained for 90 days by default for debugging; retention can be shortened per account.
- Training-on-customer-data: by default Redwood does not use customer prompts or content to improve shared model weights unless customers opt in.
- Data residency: we can pin inference to the us-west region and store logs in your VPC for Private deployments.

You mentioned Acme Finance requires an explicit opt-out for training-on-customer-data for all envs. I attached a one-page opt-out form for signature. Could you confirm whether the signed form covers both sandbox and production, and reply with a copy of the signed form? Once we have that I'll loop in Rishi (security/compliance) to update the account settings and HubSpot record.

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (security summary), acme_opt_out_form_draft.pdf

Next steps:
1) Emily: sign & return the opt-out form (or confirm via email).
2) Marissa: upon receipt, escalate to Rishi & Kimberly to apply account-level flag.
3) Redwood: confirm within 48 hours when opt-out is in place and which environments are covered.

Thanks — talk soon.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0147
From: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@acmefin.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Lopez <t.lopez@acmefin.com>, Acme Finance Legal <legal@acmefin.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: data handling confirmations + opt-out form

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. Confirming: Acme Finance requests that Redwood NOT use any Acme Finance customer data (including prompts, user content, attachments) to train or improve shared model weights for any environment (sandbox, staging, or production).

I have signed the attached opt-out form and attached as acme_opt_out_form_signed.pdf. Legal has reviewed and is fine with the one-page confirmation.

We also appreciate the SOC2 summary; our security team may reach out with a couple of follow-ups around specific logging fields.

Best,
Emily
Emily Zhang
Head of Product, Acme Finance
emily.zhang@acmefin.com
